notes: admissions: admission_type now uses the Encounter type codes (G0378 / 9921x = observation) plus an ED child encounter to tell EU OBSERVATION / DIRECT OBSERVATION / OBSERVATION ADMIT; 3 rows still differ (EW EMER. vs DIRECT EMER., one DIRECT OBSERVATION) and the FHIR data has nothing that separates them. marital_status: NOT recoverable for 9 rows - the Patient has a single maritalStatus and the Encounter carries none, while the database varies it per admission (looked at Patient, Encounter, all Encounter elements). diagnoses_icd: restricted to hospital encounters (ED-encounter conditions removed); matches exactly. transfers: added a no-careunit row at each location's end time that no next location starts at, and Emergency Department rows (no hadm_id) for ED encounters with no parent; 4 ED rows still missing. microbiologyevents: one row per organism per susceptibility result (join to micro-susc observations), and charttime NULL for midnight-only times on tests with no encounter; 4 rows still differ. prescriptions: mixes (medication with 2 ingredients) now take the base solution's dose from the mix code (e.g. D5W250 -> 250) and the additive's dose from its code when the request's dose merely repeats the bag volume; this fixed part of dose_val_rx (2542 -> 2269 rows lacking). Still NOT recoverable: range doses ('1-2', '0.5-5', '3-10') - the MedicationRequest has no doseRange, the MedicationDispense has only route and frequency code, no MedicationAdministration links to those requests; many base-solution doses whose code is non-numeric (e.g. METRBASE, NTGBASE); and 767 starttimes where the request has no dispenseRequest.validityPeriod (the database has the next scheduled hour such as 08:00/20:00; only authoredOn is in FHIR, no Administration or Dispense time exists for them). labevents: valuenum is NULL when the Quantity has a comparator (> or >=), as in the database; remaining 48 differences are the one-hour DST export conversion. d_ tables only list what occurs in the data. fhir_id and medication_fhir_id columns unchanged.
